> Please show your environment variable value of SSL_CERT_FILE and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS

⏺ Bash(echo "SSL_CERT_FILE: $SSL_CERT_FILE" && echo "NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: $NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS")
  ⎿  SSL_CERT_FILE: /Users/user/ZscalerRootCA.pem
     NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: /Users/user/ZscalerRootCA.pem

⏺ Both SSL_CERT_FILE and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS are set to /Users/user/ZscalerRootCA.pem, indicating you're using Zscaler's corporate proxy with custom CA certificates.
